                                      id,

                                      adjust_speed_25d_1,

                                      up_speed_25d_1,

                                      down_speed_10d_1,

                                      speed_dev_10d_1,
                                      speed_dev_10d_2,
                                      speed_dev_25d_1,
                                      speed_dev_25d_2,
                                      adjust_width_10d,
                                      adjust_width_25d,
                                      up_width_10d,
                                      up_width_25d,
                                      down_width_10d,
                                      down_width_25d,
                                      width_dev_10d,
                                      width_dev_25d,
                                      entrytime,
                                      updatetime,
                                      tmstamp,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
